excerpts.text: **Ariane flight VA256** was an [Ariane 5](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ariane_5 "Ariane 5") rocket flight that launched the [James Webb Space Telescope](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/James_Webb_Space_Telescope "James Webb Space Telescope") (JWST) into space on 25 December 2021.[[3]](#cite_note-ArianeRelease20211225-3) It was 2021's final Ariane flight, its most valuable payload to date, and the 256th [Ariane](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ariane_(rocket_family) "Ariane (rocket family)") mission. The launch was described by NASA as "flawless" and "perfect".[[4]](#cite_note-reaction-4)
